question: What ritual actions complete the placement after the pervasive phase?
premises: The action occurs at the end of the pervasive phase.
The yoni-mudrā is placed at the mouth.
inference: The rite concludes the pervasive phase by placing the yoni-mudrā at the mouth and offering salutation.
plain_english: At the end of the pervasive phase, place the yoni-mudrā at the mouth and offer salutation.
